Name: Phichol
Summary: Phichol was the commander of Abimelech's army who stood beside the king in his covenants with Abraham and with Isaac.
KeyStory: Phichol witnessed Abimelech's treaty with Abraham at Beersheba, and years later the same kind of treaty with Isaac.
RelatedPeople: Abimelech, King of Gerar; Abraham; Isaac
LifeLesson: Faithful service is remembered even when it is only a name in someone else's story.
